games.title: The Contaminated City
games.place: A wide river city, three days after a freight-yard fire.
games.role: Chief Scientific Officer · Riverton Contamination Response
games.drama: A freight yard beside the river burned last night, and nobody can say what came off it. You are the city's Chief Scientific Officer, which means what gets measured — and what the city is told about it — is decided by you.
concepts: Atomic structure, ions and electron configuration
Kinetic molecular theory, diffusion and volatility
Thermochemistry: enthalpy, calorimetry, energy balance
Colligative properties
Concentration units and conversions: ppm, mg/L, molarity

games.course: Matter, mixtures and clean water · physical science
games.place: A wide river city, three days after a freight-yard fire.
games.role: Chief Scientific Officer · Riverton Contamination Response
games.drama: A freight yard beside the river burned last night, and nobody can say what came off it. You are the city's chief scientist, which means you decide what gets measured, and what the city gets told.
concepts: Everything is made of matter, and matter comes in solids, liquids and gases
Dilution: adding water lowers the concentration and not the amount

Acids and bases, and why the middle is where things are stable
Saying what you know and how well you know it

games.title: Red Sand
games.place: A propellant plant on Mars: modules buried in regolith along one track, under a butterscotch sky.
games.drama: Everyone here goes home on a rocket, and the rocket can only leave when Mars and Earth line up. You are the propellant lead at Arcadia Rise, so every kilogram loaded into that rocket is signed for by you.
concepts: Stoichiometry as a feed rate: turning a production target into kilograms in
Rate constants, and how steeply they climb with temperature
Electrolysis: driving a reaction that will not run on its own
Intermolecular forces, and why they set a boiling point
What an assay is for, and what a specification is a list of

games.title: Red Sand
games.place: A propellant plant on Mars: modules buried in regolith along one track, under a butterscotch sky.
games.drama: The window opens on sol 486 and does not open again for twenty-six months. You are the propellant lead, which means the plant is yours: the reactor, the water, the power and the cold end.
concepts: Everything is made of atoms, and atoms are never lost
Temperature is how fast the particles are moving
More surface means more places for a reaction to happen
Cooling a mixture separates it, one substance at a time
Change one thing at a time and see what moves

games.title: Yellow Bay
games.place: A wafer fab mid yield crash: two gowned wings joined by a glass crossing over the subfab, and the litho end lit amber.
games.drama: Fab 7 has been losing four wafers in ten since the second week of March, and the qualification lot for the customer that buys sixty per cent of what this plant makes has to run in fifteen days. You are the process integration lead, which means the signature on that lot is yours and so is every decision between here and it.
concepts: Atomic structure: protons, electrons and the shells they occupy
Percent composition: what a formula asserts about a film
Two lots that measure the same: when a specification cannot tell them apart
Lattice energy: what it costs to pull an ionic solid apart
Surface oxidation: a clean surface, and what the air does to it in minutes

games.title: Headwater
games.place: Ashfell Dam from the inside — galleries, a gate chamber, and a hundred metres of air off the crest.
games.drama: Ashfell Dam holds ninety-two million cubic metres of water in a gorge, with four villages along the river below it. You are the duty engineer, so the amount of water let out each morning is ordered by you.
concepts: Limits, one-sided limits, and where a limit fails to exist
Related rates
The definite integral as an accumulation, and its units
Exponential growth and decay, and half-life
Reading a quantity off the graph of its own derivative

games.title: The Trial
games.place: One long floor, where walking north is distance from the patient.
games.drama: CLARION-3 has been running for four years: 2,400 people across thirty-one hospitals, half of them getting a new drug and half the usual treatment. You are the methodology and operations lead at the coordinating centre, so the pack the independent monitoring board reads is the pack you assemble.
concepts: Why a comparison needs a control arm at all
Hard endpoints against judged ones, and blinded adjudication
Multiplicity: every extra look and every extra slice costs something
Confidence intervals: what a point estimate does not say
Consent, and the obligations a trial keeps to the people in it

games.title: The Trial
games.course: Fair tests, averages and evidence · science practices
games.place: One long floor, where walking north is distance from the patient.
games.drama: CLARION-3 has been running for four years. You are the methods and operations lead at the coordinating centre, which means the pack the safety board reads is the pack you put together.
concepts: A fair test changes one thing and keeps the rest the same
Not knowing who got what, and why that helps
The average, and how spread out the readings are
Counting everybody in the group they were put in
What the people in the trial are owed

games.title: Sightline
games.place: A hall with a street corner built across one end, and the identification distance painted on the floor.
games.drama: On a November night in 2019, a stranger watched a robbery from the far side of Ferrier Street. You are the review analyst at the Conviction Integrity Unit, which means the report that goes to the review board in fifteen working days is the one you write.
concepts: Acuity as an angle: what the eye can resolve falls off with distance
Encoding: memory is built at the moment, from what was attended to
Arousal and encoding: the amygdala, cortisol and the inverted U
Post-identification feedback and confidence inflation
False confession: minimisation, maximisation and the innocent person's arithmetic

games.title: Sightline
games.course: How memory and eyesight work · science practices
games.place: A hall with a street corner built across one end, and the identification distance painted on the floor.
games.drama: On a November night in 2019, a stranger watched a robbery from the other side of Ferrier Street. You are the review analyst at the Conviction Integrity Unit, which means the report that goes to the board in fifteen days is yours to write.
concepts: Memory is rebuilt each time, not played back
Repeat a measurement and take the average
Two witnesses who talk end up agreeing
How sure somebody is, and when they said it
What a report may say, and what it may not

games.title: Quantum
games.place: A laboratory spine that is a temperature gradient, walked end to end.
games.drama: Ridgeway runs a quantum processor: twelve qubits, held a hundredth of a degree above absolute zero by a refrigerator the size of a wardrobe. You lead the group.
concepts: Energy quantisation, and why a level spacing sets everything else
Resonance, detuning, and finding a qubit frequency
The microwave chain: attenuation, amplification and noise temperature
The standard quantum limit, and beating it with squeezing
Provenance of data, and what a shared calibration hides

games.title: Bring Them Home
games.place: Mission Control: four tiers stepping down to a wall of plot boards. The teams are rows, not rooms.
games.drama: Three people are in a spacecraft on the far side of a quarter-million miles, and something aboard has just exploded. You are the flight director, and the calls are yours to make.
concepts: Vectors and components
Torque and moment of inertia
Series, parallel and load management
Springs and Hooke's law
Graphical analysis of motion data

concepts: Speed, distance and time, and how they give each other
Rates: how fast something is used up, and how long it lasts
Circuits: a break, a short, and why a battery has limits

Ordering work when several things are wrong at once

games.title: Deep Watch
games.place: A submarine — one line of ten compartments, hatches between them, and no sky at all.
games.role: Reasoning Under Pressure Beneath the Surface
games.drama: You have the watch on a submarine at ninety metres. Everybody aboard is asleep, on watch, or working in a compartment they cannot see out of.
concepts: Sound as a wave: frequency, wavelength, speed
Bearings, triangulation and geometry
Gas laws and life support
Diffraction, beamwidth and array directivity
Human factors: checklists, handover and communication

games.title: Deep Watch

games.role: Reasoning Under Pressure Beneath the Surface
games.drama: You have the watch on a submarine, ninety metres down. Nobody aboard can see out, and neither can you.
concepts: Sound is a wave, and it travels through water as well as air
Hearing something quiet next to something loud
Heat moves from hot to cold, and it needs a path
A rate: how fast something builds up or drains away
Two instruments that share a source are really one instrument

games.title: Project Y
games.place: A mesa laboratory in 1943. Chalkboards and typed sheets, and no screens anywhere.
games.drama: It is April 1943, and the site is three weeks old: a boys' school on a mesa in New Mexico, with a laboratory going up around it. You are a scientist newly assigned to Project Y.
concepts: Nuclear structure: protons, neutrons, isotopes, nuclide notation
Criticality: mass, geometry, reflectors, moderation
Units and conversions: MeV, u, barns, scientific notation
Inverse-square law for radiation intensity
Criticality safety: administrative limits and controls

games.title: Ground Truth
games.place: A lightning research station on a salt flat: a sixty-metre mast, a launch rail, and a storm coming in.
games.role: Measurements Lead · Station 12, where lightning is made on purpose
games.drama: Station 12 makes lightning on purpose. You are the measurements lead, which means no number reaches the season report unless you can show where it came from.
concepts: Charge, and where it sits on a conductor
Potential and field as derivative and integral of one another
Resistance, resistivity and the ground as a resistor
Magnetic flux through a surface
Measurement in the right regime: shunts, dividers and what they load

games.title: Blackout
games.place: Calder Switching Station, and two circuits of lattice towers walking off the edge of the map.
games.drama: Four million people are supplied from the Calder network, and the whole of it runs on one number. You are the system operator on nights.
concepts: Charge, current, voltage and resistance
Reactance, impedance and phasors
Faraday's law and electromagnetic induction
Fault current and short-circuit analysis
Load shedding as a decision under uncertainty

games.title: Aftershock
games.place: Kestrel Bay three days after, where the fault broke the surface and you can walk the scarp.
games.drama: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake hit Kestrel Bay three days ago and the town is still standing, unevenly. You are the building safety coordinator, which means you decide which buildings people are allowed back into: green to enter, yellow for restricted use, red for nobody.
concepts: P and S waves, and what the gap between them measures

Documentation: the record somebody inherits

games.title: Planetary Defense
games.place: A mountain ridge: one road, domes with open shutters, a thirty-metre dish and red service lamps.
games.drama: A survey telescope flagged a faint moving point near the ecliptic four hours ago. You direct the campaign: the telescopes that track it, a radar window that opens once in eleven years, and a deflection mission that would have to launch years before anyone could be certain it is needed.
concepts: Celestial coordinates and angular measure
Orbital elements and orbit determination
Probability, risk and expected value

Crater and blast scaling; ground effects

games.drama: Four hours ago a survey telescope found a faint dot moving against the stars. You run the campaign.
concepts: Telling a real object from an artefact, by repeating the observation
Scale and distance in the solar system

games.title: Safety Factor
games.place: Seven rides at Corbin Park, and an inspector who will not take a number nobody can derive.
games.drama: Corbin Park lost its certificate in October and the season opens in three weeks. You are the ride engineer, hired in February.
concepts: Velocity against speed: direction is part of the quantity

games.title: Ice Core
games.place: A deep-drilling camp on a polar plateau, with the flattest, emptiest horizon in the set.
games.drama: Vestri Dome is a drilling camp on the polar plateau: six huts up on legs, a trench with a tower over it, and two and a half kilometres of ice already pulled out of the ground. You are the season science lead, which means the climate record this station sends home is the one you signed.
concepts: Why ice keeps a record at all: burial without melting
Stable isotopes as a thermometer: δ¹⁸O and deuterium
Dust and tephra: aridity, wind and where the dust came from

games.title: Wellmere
games.place: A breeding station on a headland, ringed by isolation distance. Sea on three sides and one causeway in.
